course_outline_concepts: Cui 2025 entropy mechanism: R = -a·exp(H)+b empirical law
Entropy collapse threshold (H<0.1 nats); Clip-Cov / KL-Cov interventions
KL-control math: k1/k2/k3 estimators (Schulman's KL tricks blog)
Max-ent RL ancestry (Haarnoja 2018 SAC) — what LM-RL inherited and what it dropped

sources.what_to_extract: R = -a·exp(H)+b empirical law; mechanistic theorem ΔH ∝ -Cov(log π(a|s), A(s,a)); Clip-Cov top-k covariance-based gradient detach; KL-Cov token-level k3 penalty on same outliers; collapse threshold H<0.1 nats; algorithm-agnostic shape across PPO/GRPO/RLOO/Reinforce++; Qwen2.5-7B / Qwen2.5-Math-7B gains.

Andrychowicz 2020 hyperparameter ranking; c_H ∈ [0, 0.005] default; advantage normalization > entropy bonus in effect size; ε=0.2 PPO default; linear-decay LR > constant; collapse signature (H falls from 2-3 nats to <0.1 in a few hundred updates).

A3C/PPO entropy-bonus loss L = L_CLIP - c_v L_VF + c_H H(π); Atari defaults c_v≈0.5, c_H≈0.01, ε=0.2; LLM-RL carry-through with c_H typically 0 in GRPO; why flat bonus under-corrects in large-vocab regimes.

SAC max-ent objective J = Σ E[r + α·H(π)]; soft-Bellman V(s) = α·log∫exp(Q/α); optimal policy π* ∝ exp(Q/α); auto-α tuning L(α) = E[-α(log π + H̄)], H̄ = -dim(A); LLM-RL inheritance as target-entropy control; what was dropped (off-policy replay, soft Q-critic).

k1 = -log(p/q) unbiased but signed, high variance; k2 = 0.5·(log(p/q))² biased but low variance; k3 = (p/q - 1) - log(p/q) unbiased, non-negative, convex f(r)=r-1-log r ≥ 0 with min at r=1; RLHF/GRPO convention; Costa Huang's 'k3 exploded in TRL' caveat and DeepSeek GRPO success.

Entropy as bottleneck metric in 2025 reasoning-RL; when H < 0.2 nats stop and inspect; why entropy bonus alone insufficient; cold-start SFT as entropy-stabilizer; temperature as debugging first-move; GRPO's value-free advantage makes collapse easier to monitor.

Framework-level triage: confirm KL-to-ref on, bump T by 0.1-0.2, raise c_H an order of magnitude, check advantage normalization, then reward; OpenRLHF default c_H=0, verl 1e-3; β ∈ 0.01-0.1; adaptive-KL; advantage-norm ON in OpenRLHF/verl, OFF in TRL.

verl kl_penalty switch k1/k2/k3; OpenRLHF AdaptiveKLController reward-shaping pattern; TRL PPO K1 reward-shape + K2 approx monitor + K3 optional; TRL GRPO K3 as loss term with β; 'two entropies in TRL PPO' (objective/entropy vs policy/entropy_avg); collapse signature across frameworks (entropy falls 30% in <100 steps, ppo_kl >0.1, clipfrac→1).

Rollout T = 1.0 baseline; raising T widens support without changing parameters; top-p/top-k introduce off-policy bias PPO cannot absorb; Tülu-3 anneal T=1.0 RLVR → T=0.7 DPO polish; R1 T=1.0 top_p=0.95; re-warming after collapse: bump T by 0.2 for N rollouts; tempered-sampling formula P_T(a) = softmax(z/T).

RLHF objective J = E[r] - β·KL(π‖π_ref); InstructGPT β ≈ 0.02; KL-to-reward per-token shaping r̂_t = r_t - β·(log π_φ - log π_ref); Korbak 2022 Bayesian view π* ∝ π_ref · exp(r/β); reverse-KL = mode-seeking; DPO's implicit KL r_θ = β·log(π/π_ref); why KL-in-reward not KL-in-loss for PPO.
